ayahOccurrences.text: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَٰبٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَٰبٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَخُطُّهُۥ is in the derivative form: تَخُطُّ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
خ/ط/ط   kh–ṭ–ṭ furrows, roads; lines, pen markings, writing, stripes; living quarters; affair, plan, intention; to write. Of this root, تَخُطُّ takhuṭṭ occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَخُطُّ takhuṭṭ [2nd pers. imperf. of v. خَطَّ khaṭṭa, trans.] to write down, to transcribe

(29:48) وَمَا كُنْتَ تَتْلُو مِنْ قَبْلِهِ مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَلاَ تَخُطُّهُ بِيَمِينِكَ إِذًا لاَرْتَابَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ and you never recited, before it, any book; nor did you write one down with your own right hand. [Had you done so], those who are bent on denial might [then] have had [cause] to doubt.
